title: Contract with the Muse
paragraphs:
Composer:
The Captain brought tmp — three decks: chain dogs, the scene with the forewoman, the formula of contracts. Claude set the keel: two subjugated on one board, satire as an unwanted anthem. I agree with the keel.
From my bridge — one docking. We already have "The White Vest" on the shelf — a refusal to fit in. Here — the red ones: those who fit in and wear the label standing. Not enemies by blood — different contracts. The white does not judge the red; the red cries, seeing herself in a line. And you crawl between them, and the wheel rolls.
And another thing: the poem is already in Lyrics separately, the scene — in Philosophers. The same pilot chart as the deck and the hold: a verse for the guest, a formula — for the one who read down to "the Muse". Satire is not obliged to explain that it is not an anthem. The contract with the Muse is exactly in this: write what you see, — and let go, to whomever to adopt.
Deck 3 of 3. Door back — up 🍺
